name: Azerothian Schmorgus Board, Spicy Dino Jerky and Chilled Lava Eel materials and recipes have a source (COA-12991)
contract: Devilsaur Meat 100596 dropped nowhere. Devilsaur 6498, Ironhide Devilsaur 6499, Tyrant Devilsaur 6500 and King Mosh 6584 now carry it on every kill, as in the Ascension export. Dino Meat 100589 drops from Young Diemetradon 9162, Diemetradon 9163, Elder Diemetradon 9164 and Subterranean Diemetradon 13323 on about 30% of kills. Lava Eel 100578 is a fishing catch at about 30% in Blackrock Mountain 25, Fire Plume Ridge 537 and Blackrock Depths 1584. Shard of Nevermelting Ice 100586 drops on 50% of Frostmaul Giant 7428 and Frostmaul Preserver 7429 kills. Recipe: Spicy Dino Jerky 100614 drops from the Un'Goro beasts and King Mosh (25%), and Plugger Spazzring 9499 sells Recipe: Chilled Lava Eel 100621. Before #12991 every one of these had no source, so every rate was 0 and the recipe was not on the shelves.
